title: A magnet near its critical point (Ising)

data.source: Exact enumeration of all 65536 states of the 4 x 4 Ising model with periodic edges (computed, not sampled)

prediction: Heating or cooling a magnet traces a line of distributions with two different ends (distance above 3, the most possible being 3.14), not a circle, so CRR's rules have no half turn to cut at and say nothing.
baseline: Exact statistical mechanics of the Ising model and the standard information geometry of temperature, in which the metric is the variance of the energy.
why: The family of states is an open line, so there is no loop, no cut and nothing that could have come out for or against CRR. The length along the line is a standard quantity (it is built from the heat capacity).
